correctness.rationale: Represent the fourteen vertices by eight inner sign vectors (±1,±1,±1)/4 and six outer axis vectors ±e_i/2. The cube-vertex/face bipartite incidence adjacency matrix has characteristic polynomial z^6(z²-4)^3(z²-12), so eigenvalue 2 is second largest with multiplicity three. The 14x3 coordinate columns are exact orthonormal 2-eigenvectors. Independent SymPy/rational checks reconstructed all of this without relying on the packaged verify log. The eight inner vertex squared radii are 3/16 and six outer squared radii 1/4; outer axis contacts force the unique minimum enclosing sphere of radius1/2. Exactly twelve inequalities ±x_i±x_j≤1/2 (i<j) support four affinely independent facet vertices each, giving inradius 1/(2sqrt2) and, via the opposite facet pairs, a unique incenter. Every edge length is sqrt3/4; finite exact checks cover entire 14-vertex polyhedron.
residual_risks: The metric constants require orthonormal spectral eigenvector normalization and are not invariant under arbitrary affine deformations.
